finding.headline: "The No-Village Mama (No Family Support)"
finding.problem: "Back home my mum would cook pepper soup and I'd just heal. Here it's just me and a freezer. I'm hungry, lonely, and craving the food that feels like home."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A 28-yr-old diaspora Nigerian whose omugwo never came (mum abroad/can't travel); isolated, craves familiar West African food for comfort but doesn't know quick versions; cried wanting "a piece of pizza" (MomWell Benin story).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone / Bundle anchor — "Your Omugwo in a Box: West African Comfort Meals for the Mama With No Village."". Verdict: PASSES (22/25)..
